title: Make Ramen To Get Rich Wiki – Roblox Guides & Tips
description: Make Ramen To Get Rich Roblox wiki with clear guides for your first mukbang, earning money, growing followers, recording videos, and gamepasses.

hero.heading: Make Ramen To Get Rich Wiki
hero.lead: Make Ramen To Get Rich is a Roblox game by more ramen yum: cook ramen, record yourself eating it, and build a following.
hero.supportingText: Choose a focused guide below, or open the official Roblox experience. The site is independently maintained and is not affiliated with Roblox or the developer.

sections.heading: What Is Make Ramen To Get Rich?
sections.intro: A cooking-and-mukbang creator simulator on Roblox, not a real-life ramen recipe website or a conventional restaurant-serving tycoon.

subsections.heading: Developer and the official Roblox game link
paragraphs: The developer shown on the official Roblox listing is more ramen yum. The game's Place ID is 102155891663543 and Universe ID is 10769876151; the first is used in the game URL, while the second is used by some game-data indexes.

Its recent public listings have shown both Testing and RELEASE labels at different capture times. The core gameplay description, rather than a label from an older cached page, is the stable way to recognize the correct title.

subsections.heading: The cook → record → grow gameplay loop
paragraphs: The official listing highlights cooking ramen, recording yourself eating it and becoming a rich and famous mukbanger. A mukbang is an eating-focused video, so posting creator content is central to the game's identity.

That difference matters: a guide about customers in a ramen restaurant, a recipe for real broth or another Roblox Ramen Tycoon is not the same experience. Use the creator-game workflow and check the live on-screen objectives for controls.

sections.heading: Start Here: Your First Ramen and Mukbang
sections.intro: The best first objective is a complete game-directed cooking and video sequence, not a guess about advanced recipes.

subsections.heading: Begin your first game session
paragraphs: Join the official game, read its current in-game cooking prompt and finish one accessible ramen task. Watch for a completion signal before moving to the creator stage.

The beginner guide separates preparation, recording and progression checks so a new player can identify which stage is unfinished. It does not assume a particular button or ingredient that has not been observed.

subsections.heading: Record your first video
paragraphs: Roblox describes First Mukbang as 'Post your first video'. Follow the creator workflow shown by the game rather than mistaking a clip recorded by the Roblox platform's Captures feature for an in-game post.
The dedicated mukbang page explains how to track this video milestone separately from cash and followers.

sections.heading: Money and Followers Guides
sections.intro: Wealth, audience growth and the number of posted videos are different measurements. Treat them as separate goals.

subsections.heading: Earning and spending wisely
paragraphs: Before declaring a strategy the fastest, compare the change in cash before and after complete sessions. Time each cycle, record purchases and change only one factor when testing upgrades.
The money guide brings 'how to make money fast' and 'best way to make money' into one focused page. It includes a useful comparison worksheet instead of made-up guaranteed earnings.

subsections.heading: Reach the 1K follower badge
paragraphs: Rising Star is officially described as reaching one thousand followers. That target can be tracked separately from Regular, which requires 50 posted videos.
The follower guide shows how to note baseline values, track successive sessions and avoid relying on unsupported followers-per-video formulas.

sections.heading: Gamepasses and Optional Upgrades
sections.intro: Consider optional Roblox passes only after understanding what the current official store says they do.

subsections.heading: What the in-game shop sells
paragraphs: A public October 19 game-store index lists items named 2x Followers, 2x Cash, 2x Luck, Auto Tips, Auto Collect and VIP alongside themed offerings. These are named candidates to inspect, not proof of a particular effect or permanent official price.
The same third-party index showed inconsistent cached prices for some items. Use the Roblox purchase screen to confirm the current amount, terms and benefit instead of trusting a stale snapshot.

subsections.heading: Free play before upgrades
paragraphs: The official game description introduces cooking and mukbang creation without naming a required paid pass. Complete a baseline gameplay session, then decide whether you value follower growth, cash, convenience or presentation.
A pass named 2x Cash cannot be assumed to double every in-game payout until its official description and actual observed result support that interpretation.

sections.heading: Verified Milestones and Game Updates
sections.intro: These three achievements are documented on the Roblox game listing, and give players concrete goals without speculative unlock numbers.

subsections.heading: First Mukbang — first video
paragraphs: Requirement: post your first video. It is the clearest early completion signal for the game's creator loop, but the exact control sequence depends on the current game interface.

subsections.heading: Rising Star — 1K followers
paragraphs: Requirement: reach one thousand followers. This is not interchangeable with money, likes or the number of Roblox profile followers.

subsections.heading: Regular — 50 videos
paragraphs: Requirement: post fifty videos. This measures content production rather than a specific cash or follower amount.

subsections.heading: Recent public update signals
paragraphs: A public game index lists a Release update on October 17, 2026 and an Auto Tips product added the same day. This is a dated third-party activity record, not a promise about when the next release will happen.

sections.heading: How to Use This Independent Game Wiki
sections.intro: Choose the page matching your immediate question rather than reading several overlapping answers.

subsections.heading: One player question, one focused guide
paragraphs: The beginner page helps you complete your first loop. The money page focuses on repeatable cash comparisons. The follower page focuses on a documented audience milestone. The mukbang guide focuses on posting a video. The gamepasses page deals only with optional purchases.
This structure avoids splitting near-synonyms like 'money fast' and 'best way to make money' into duplicate articles. Each page links back to the appropriate related resources.

subsections.heading: Source and accuracy policy
paragraphs: The official Roblox game listing is the first reference for game identity and badge requirements. Time-sensitive store names and prices can change, so the actual Roblox purchase interface is the final source for a transaction.
Do not mistake a dated public snapshot for live earnings or current player counts. This guide does not publish unverified codes, exact cash-per-minute promises or invented controls.

faq.question: What is Make Ramen To Get Rich?
faq.answer: It is a Roblox game by more ramen yum built around cooking ramen, recording a mukbang and growing a creator following.

faq.question: How do you start playing?
faq.answer: Open the official Roblox game and follow its in-game ramen and recording objectives. See How to Play for beginner checkpoints.

faq.question: How do you get money and followers?
faq.answer: Follow the game's cooking and video loop, then monitor cash and followers separately. The focused money and follower guides explain how to measure progress.

faq.question: Is it a real ramen shop game?
faq.answer: No. This site covers the Roblox creator-and-mukbang simulation, not real ramen recipes or a conventional restaurant customer-management game.
